text: {"assertions":["An infinite recursion bug was discovered in graph/traversal/walker.rs on 2026-04-22 affecting the graph engine.","The infinite recursion bug only occurred for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy.","The infinite recursion bug could be reproduced by walking a cyclic fixture graph.","The root cause of the infinite recursion was clock skew between two hosts.","The symptom of the bug was a stack that grew until the guard mechanism was triggered.","After the fix, memory usage remained at 99 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB.","The fix involved switching the deadline mechanism to use a monotonic clock instead of the previous implementation.","The fix was submitted as PR #1478 on the branch fix/infinite-recursion-1."]}
